name: ACU Alumni Tuition Discount
description: ACU bachelor's and master's alumni may receive 20% off eligible online graduate tuition. For an online social work master's, applicants without a BSW should review the standard MSSW path. Fees and field-placement costs are separate. This is a tuition reduction, not cash.

funding.amountDescription: 20% off eligible graduate tuition; fees excluded.
funding.applicationCycle: Request alumni eligibility confirmation for the intended term.
funding.stackingPolicy: Cannot combine with other ACU institutional scholarships or tuition discounts. Confirm external-award treatment with ACU. Terms: https://acu.edu/admissions-aid/online/financial-aid/online-scholarships/
funding.nextStep: Request a written tuition estimate for the standard online social-work master's, with the alumni discount applied. Confirm fees, field-placement costs, and how outside awards affect the total.

name: P.E.O. Program for Continuing Education Grant
description: One-time need-based grant of up to $4,000 for women returning to education after at least 24 consecutive months away. Applicants must already be in an eligible program, be within 18 months of completion, and receive a local chapter recommendation. An existing master's or doctorate excludes eligibility; a first master's may qualify. The program must improve employment prospects.

other_requirements: Living and studying in the United States or Canada.
Accredited program must improve marketable employment skills; prerequisites and doctoral study are excluded.
No immediate continuation of education beyond the program for which the grant is requested.

funding.amountDescription: One-time award of up to $4,000; amount depends on documented need.
funding.applicationCycle: Chapter recommendation and invitation precede an application; check timing with the chapter.
funding.fundingTiming: For a current program within 18 months of completion.
funding.stackingPolicy: Report other aid; award is based on remaining eligible educational need.
funding.nextStep: Check your education gap and expected completion date. Once enrolled and within 18 months of finishing, use the provider's potential-sponsorship form to request a local chapter review.

name: Consuelo W. Gosnell Memorial Scholarship
description: MSW scholarship recognizing commitment to American Indian/Alaska Native and Hispanic/Latino communities or work with public/voluntary nonprofit agencies and grassroots groups. The published ceiling is up to $5,000; next-cycle details need confirmation.

other_requirements: Applied to or accepted into a CSWE-accredited MSW program.
Demonstrated commitment to the named communities, public/voluntary nonprofit agencies, or grassroots groups.

funding.applicationCycle: 2027-2028 cycle expected to open in January 2027; exact opening/closing dates and amounts require confirmation. 2026-2027 awards have been allocated.
funding.stackingPolicy: Confirm other-aid and school packaging rules with the provider.
funding.amountDescription: Published award ceiling up to $5,000; next-cycle amount unconfirmed.
funding.nextStep: Track the next application cycle on the NASW Foundation page. Confirm NASW membership, program accreditation, GPA, and evidence of your work with the named communities or agencies.

name: Verne LaMarr Lyons Memorial Scholarship
description: MSW funding for students with demonstrated interest in or experience with health and mental-health practice, with a commitment to work in African American communities. The prior published award was $4,000; availability and next-cycle amount require confirmation.

other_requirements: Interest or experience in health/mental-health practice and commitment to African American communities.

funding.applicationCycle: 2027-2028 cycle expected to open in January 2027; exact opening/closing dates and amounts require confirmation. 2026-2027 awards have been allocated.
funding.stackingPolicy: Confirm other-aid and school packaging rules with the provider.
funding.amountDescription: Prior published award: $4,000; next-cycle amount unconfirmed.
funding.nextStep: Track the next NASW cycle and gather evidence of your health or mental-health experience and service goals. Confirm membership, program accreditation, and GPA requirements.

name: Lawanna Renee Barron Scholarship
description: BSW/MSW scholarship for students with an interest in serving rural communities and/or addressing mental-health needs in African American communities. The prior published award was $2,000; next-cycle amount requires confirmation.

other_requirements: Interest in rural communities and/or mental-health needs in African American communities.

funding.applicationCycle: 2027-2028 cycle expected to open in January 2027; exact opening/closing dates and amounts require confirmation. 2026-2027 awards have been allocated.
funding.stackingPolicy: Confirm other-aid and school packaging rules with the provider.
funding.amountDescription: Prior published award: $2,000; next-cycle amount unconfirmed.
funding.nextStep: Check the next NASW cycle and prepare examples of rural-community service or African American mental-health work. Confirm membership, program accreditation, and GPA requirements.

name: UTA Title IV-E MSW Stipend
description: School-specific MSW child-welfare stipend. Published MSW stipend is $7,050 with qualifying employment obligations. This is an alternative-school opportunity; it cannot fund ACU or GCU study. Applicants must confirm placement and online-program compatibility.

other_requirements: Eligible child-welfare specialization and advanced block placement.
Apply in the semester before the eligible block placement.
Confirm online-program and practicum compatibility with the Title IV-E program.

funding.amountDescription: Published MSW stipend $7,050, subject to program selection and contract.
funding.applicationCycle: Placement-specific application timing; confirm current cohort availability.
funding.serviceObligation: Eight months of qualifying employment per stipend received; review the agreement and repayment consequences before accepting.
funding.stackingPolicy: Confirm stipend and other-aid interactions with UTA.
funding.nextStep: Consider this route only if UTA is a school option. Review the employment and repayment agreement, and ask the program about the application deadline before your planned practicum semester.

name: ACU Corporate Partner Tuition Discount
description: Employees of ACU corporate partners can receive a 10% online tuition reduction and an application-fee waiver. Verify the employer agreement and program coverage. ACU alumni should compare the separate alumni discount before selecting a benefit.

other_requirements: Current employment with an eligible ACU corporate partner and applicable program coverage must be confirmed by ACU.

funding.amountDescription: 10% reduction on eligible online tuition; application fee waived.
funding.stackingPolicy: Do not add this to the alumni discount. Request written confirmation of which benefit applies and whether outside awards can combine.
funding.nextStep: Give ACU the employer name and intended program. Request written confirmation of the partner benefit and compare the resulting total with the alumni offer.

name: GCU Employer and Organization Alliance Scholarships
description: GCU publishes tuition-support opportunities through employer and organization alliances for online learners. This is a route to investigate, not a guaranteed MSW award. The specific agreement determines eligibility and the discount.

other_requirements: GCU must confirm an eligible employer or organization alliance, applicant relationship, intended program and study format, start term, and scholarship amount.

funding.amountDescription: Agreement-specific tuition support; no MSW amount confirmed.
funding.applicationCycle: Request the current alliance terms for the intended starting term.
funding.fundingTiming: Confirm with GCU before accepting an offer.
funding.stackingPolicy: Request a written estimate explaining institutional discounts, outside awards, fees, and any exclusions.
funding.nextStep: Ask GCU to check applicable employer and organization alliances for the online MSW. Request the exact agreement, eligible program, discount, and full net-cost estimate in writing.

other: GCU confirmation of the applicable alliance agreement
